manual_or_upload.label: Netflix viewing activity export
manual_or_upload.description: Download your viewing history instantly from netflix.com/viewingactivity (Download all), then upload the CSV here. If your account is inactive, use the full data export from netflix.com/account/getmyinfo instead (up to 30 days to prepare).

acquisition_methods.label: Download your viewing history now
acquisition_methods.detail: Go to netflix.com/viewingactivity (Account > Profiles > Viewing activity), select Download all at the bottom of the page, and upload the CSV here. Available immediately for each profile on an active account — titles and dates only.

acquisition_methods.label: Full account data export (inactive accounts, or full detail)
acquisition_methods.detail: If your account is inactive, or you want full detail (device, duration, per-session timestamps), request 'Download a copy of your personal information' at netflix.com/account/getmyinfo. Netflix emails you when it's ready — this can take up to 30 days. Upload the .zip directly, or extract it yourself and upload just CONTENT_INTERACTION/ViewingActivity.csv.

manual_or_upload.help_text: Netflix does not expose viewing history through an account API or OAuth grant. This source imports an owner-downloaded CSV: either the instant per-profile Download all export, or the full account data export.
manual_or_upload.large_file_fallback: The full Netflix data export archive can include many CSVs beyond viewing history; if the .zip exceeds the upload limit, extract it yourself and upload just CONTENT_INTERACTION/ViewingActivity.csv, or use the server import-folder handoff.
validation_expectations: Detected either the immediate Title,Date export or the full-export ViewingActivity.csv (standalone or inside the getmyinfo zip)
Duplicate, empty, unsupported, or too-large file status

refresh_policy.rationale: Netflix official export (getmyinfo) requires manual download from netflix.com/account/getmyinfo. The export takes up to 30 days and must be extracted locally. No automated refresh path exists.

public_listing.proof_gate: Import-only (CSV/zip upload); no collection path (API, OAuth, or browser capture) is implemented, so it stays out of the default picker until a real collection path lands or the owner explicitly opts in.

streams.name: viewing_activity
streams.description: Netflix viewing activity from either the immediate Download all export or the full data export.

display.label: Your Netflix viewing history
display.detail: Titles watched, with date (day-only from the immediate export, full timestamp/device/duration from the full data export). watched_at_precision and source_schema say which source each record came from.
